technique_name: Describe the impact WW2 had on world history
description: World War II had a profound impact on world history. It led to the downfall of major European powers, including Germany, Italy, and Japan, and the rise of the Soviet Union and the United States to world superstardom. As a result, much of the world is divided between the Western and Eastern world powers. The world also underwent major social and cultural changes, with women playing a larger role in public life, and the emergence of multilateral institutions such as the United Nations. Additionall
